environment: python3 -I driver (kwcall.py) loads skills/sdlc/branches.py from a worktree of sdlc/S-fix-M-1-1b; node:test; no network
surface: branches.py exports: name(fmt, kind, **parts), parse(fmt, branch, ids=None), tail(kind, **parts), split(fmt), validate_format(fmt), load_format(repo), Fail. No signature changed in this slice.

cases.title: name refuses ids that parse as another kind
cases.given: format sdlc/{name} and sdlc/{name:lower}; kinds slice and milestone; ids S-001-attempt-2, S-001-v0-cli-0, S-001-attempt-0, S-001-v10-a-b-3
cases.then: every call raises Fail that names the kind and the branch; parse still reads the ids as attempt and verify
cases.expected: every call raises Fail that names the kind and the branch; parse still reads the ids as attempt and verify
cases.actual: 16 of 16 calls raised Fail, for example: the slice branch name 'sdlc/S-001-attempt-2' does not parse back as a slice branch: parse reads kind attempt. parse reads attempt and verify as before.

cases.title: valid parts of every kind keep their names and parse back
cases.given: 4 formats x 11 valid kind and part sets, including S-fix-M-1-2, S-001-e2e and n='07'
cases.then: name equals the reference name built from the spec; parse returns the same kind and parts
cases.expected: name equals the reference name built from the spec; parse returns the same kind and parts
cases.actual: 44 of 44 names equal the reference and parse back; name('sdlc/{name}','slice',id='S-001') is sdlc/S-001

cases.title: non-ASCII ids and parts are refused
cases.given: ids with U+212A, U+017F, U+00E9, fullwidth digits, U+0130; integer parts with fullwidth and Arabic-indic digits; formats {name} and {name:lower}; kinds slice, milestone, e2e, attempt, verify, e2e-area, run
cases.actual: all calls raised Fail; fullwidth digits never pass as integers

cases.title: integer parts compare by value
cases.when: call name with kinds run and attempt
cases.then: valid values succeed and parse back by value; bad values raise Fail with no exception trace
cases.expected: valid values succeed and parse back by value; bad values raise Fail with no exception trace
cases.actual: valid values passed and parsed back by value; every bad value raised Fail; no exception outcome

cases.title: lowering touches only the tail and follows one ASCII rule
cases.given: formats Feat/PROJ-{name:lower}-X and sdlc/{name:lower}; areas with U+00C9, U+0130, U+00DF, U+1E9E, U+017F, K
cases.when: call name for e2e-area, then parse
cases.then: name equals the reference name with ASCII lowering of the tail only; prefix and suffix keep their case; parse returns the same area
cases.expected: name equals the reference name with ASCII lowering of the tail only; prefix and suffix keep their case; parse returns the same area
cases.actual: Feat/PROJ-{name:lower}-X with S-001 gives Feat/PROJ-s-001-X; all 16 area cases equal the reference and parse back; profile CLI lowers to cli

cases.title: joined prefix or suffix never gives a silent mismatch
cases.given: 7 formats with suffix -e2e, -attempt-1, -v1-a-1, -1, -attempt-2 or prefix run-; 5 kinds; 7 ids
cases.when: call name; when it returns, call parse
cases.then: each call raises Fail or parses back to the same kind and parts
cases.expected: each call raises Fail or parses back to the same kind and parts
cases.actual: 245 calls: 126 raised Fail, 119 returned and all parse back to the same kind and parts; 0 exceptions

evidence.title: run
evidence.inline: property-run: 245 example calls, fails 126, oks 119, 0 violations

cases.title: state names keep the given ts and build one when absent
cases.when: call name with no ts, with ts '', with a 14-digit ts, and with bad ts values
cases.then: no ts or empty ts builds a 14-digit UTC stamp; a given ts is used as given; every bad ts raises Fail
cases.expected: no ts or empty ts builds a 14-digit UTC stamp; a given ts is used as given; every bad ts raises Fail
cases.actual: no ts, empty ts, given ts and lowered format passed. Short, letters, fullwidth digits, leading space and '0' raised Fail. ts '20261011101010\n' (trailing line feed) returned sdlc/state-20261011101010\n, so name did not raise Fail
cases.specSource: R-019 acceptance: every name output parses back to the same parts

seeds.title: name accepts an integer part with a trailing line feed
seeds.detail:
name('sdlc/{name}','run',n='2
') returns 'sdlc/run-2
' and name('sdlc/{name}','attempt',id='S-001',n='2
') returns 'sdlc/S-001-attempt-2
'. The parse regex $ matches before a final line feed, and the round trip compares int('2
') with 2 by value. The branch name holds a line feed. The part is equal by value, so the acceptance text does not clearly forbid it. 34 of 3000 property calls hit this.

seeds.title: parse accepts a branch with a trailing line feed
seeds.detail: The patterns in PARSE_ROWS end with $, so parse('sdlc/{name}','sdlc/run-2\n') reads kind run. This is the cause of the state ts defect and of the integer seed. Use \Z or fullmatch. parse is outside this slice.

seeds.title: name never compares the state ts part
seeds.detail: TAILS['state'] lists no required parts, so _check_round_trip skips ts even when the caller gave one. A given ts that parse reads differently passes. The plan says to skip ts only when none was given.
